reason: The formula that follows is whole-model, not per-head: it multiplies n_layers x d_hidden (full hidden width across all layers) and the text itself says '(one key and one value per layer, each d_hidden wide)', yielding 2*80*8192*2 = 2,621,440 B = 2.62 MB/token - the model total. A single 128-dim head's per-token KV is 2*128*2 = 512 B per layer (40,960 B across 80 layers), so 'attention head' is wrong; 'head' should be 'model'.
